summary: Frontend regression/perf check after non-blocking font migration. Landing paints fast: DOMContentLoaded ~0.7s, hero visible ~1.3s (no blank screen). All required data-testids render (hero, dna-helix, feature-card 0/7, subject-card 0/7, pricing-free, pricing-pro, reviews-section, faq-item 0/3, nav-login-btn, hero-signup-btn, theme-toggle). H1 computed font-family = 'Cabinet Grotesk', Manrope, sans-serif (loaded successfully via non-blocking link). Dark bg applied (rgb(3,7,18)). Theme toggle flips dark<->light. Nav 'Log In' -> /app/index.html#login and #pg-onboard is display:block while #pg-landing is display:none. 'Start For Free' -> /app/index.html#signup. No page errors; only benign Canvas2D willReadFrequently warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking font pattern is correct: media='print' onload=this.media='all' with <noscript> fallback and preconnects for fonts.googleapis.com/gstatic/fontshare.
Optional micro-opt: consider adding <link rel='preload' as='style'> for the two font stylesheets to hint the browser earlier, but current impl already paints instantly.
Benign Canvas2D warning from dna-helix canvas: can set getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }) to silence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Font loading is now non-blocking via <link media='print' onload> in public/index.html; @import removed from index.css. Landing renders in ~1.3s. All landing testids intact. Static app at /app/index.html routing via hash (#login, #signup) works.
